name: MCP Public APIs
description: An MCP server that indexes the public-apis catalogue, allowing LLMs to search and filter over 1,400 public APIs by category, authentication type, and technical requirements. It facilitates precise API discovery for developers by providing tools to query specific features like HTTPS support and CORS compatibility.
